title: ClientConfig all-pub fields: no non_exhaustive, struct-literal lock-in
description: ClientConfig has four pub fields and no #[non_exhaustive]. Any caller writing ClientConfig { request_timeout: .., max_session_body: .., max_call_body: .., max_download_body: .. } will get a compile error the moment a fifth field is added (e.g. max_upload_body). This is a breaking change on a v0.1 type that fossilizes the field count. Adding #[non_exhaustive] or moving to a builder/Default-only pattern before 0.1 ships costs nothing; after it ships it requires a semver bump to fix.
